documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering, Approving & Taking On Record The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026 And To Conduct Any Other Businesses As May Be Decided By The Board.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong start to FY27, with Q1 revenue growing 58% year-on-year to INR 853.63 crores, driven by summer weddings and festive demand. EBITDA increased 70% to INR 93.99 crores with an expansion in EBITDA margin to 11.01%, while profit after tax rose 77% to INR 64 crores. The company is actively expanding its footprint through a mix of COCO and FOCO models, targeting a total of 51 stores by FY30 while focusing on lightweight jewellery and old-gold exchange initiatives. D.P. Abhushan reported a healthy performance for the first quarter of FY27, with total revenue growing by 58% year-on-year to INR 854 crore, driven by festive purchases and summer weddings.

guidance.claim: The company targets achieving around 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company targets increasing the studded ratio to 12% to 15% on an overall basis by March 2028.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: Management targets an annual top-line growth rate of approximately 25% to 30% over the next five years until 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: The company guides for an EBITDA margin of around 6% to 6.5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management plans for revenues of INR 4,800 crores for FY27 and INR 5,500 crores for FY28.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to reach between 8% and 8.5% by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: Management aims to reach a total of around 51 stores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across all operating markets during the quarter supported by festive occasions and the summer wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across all our operating markets during the quarter. People are buying jewellery not only for regular consumption but also as an investment.

demand_outlook.claim: In Q1 FY27, footfall at the stores was encouraging with a footfall-to-conversion ratio of 81%.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy during the quarter, supported by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India's gold demand is projected to remain between 600 and 700 tonnes in 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s gold demand is projected to remain in the range of 600–700 tonnes in 2026, with rising investment demand offsetting weaker jewellery consumption due to elevated gold prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold demand remains resilient in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter daily-wear, studded, and minimalist jewellery designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs. Daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs are gaining popularity

demand_outlook.claim: Silver segment revenue witnessed an exceptional increase driven by higher customer traction and improved product mix.
demand_outlook.quote: The silver segment witnessed exceptional growth, rising from INR16 crores to INR69 crores, reflecting a sharp ~333% YoY increase, driven by higher customer traction and improved product mix.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall customer conversion rate has remained largely stable at approximately 82% to 83%.
demand_outlook.quote: while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains intact and is growing as consumers shift towards it amid increasing gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod have been finalized with fit-out and development activities underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat. All key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities have been completed. Fit-out and showroom development activities are underway at both locations, and the stores will be operational soon.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq ft and operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market. This showroom will operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will be approximately 3,750 sq ft and operate as the first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized locations for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its footprint in Central India with a new showroom inauguration in Dhar, taking the total network to 12 stores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: Total retail store area stood at approximately 53,650 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open three to four new COCO stores alongside a franchise store this year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 853.63 crores compared to INR 541 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a 58% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: During Quarter 1 '27, our total revenue stood at INR853.63 crores as compared to INR541 crores in Quarter 1 FY26, registering a strong growth of 58% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 853.63 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.01%.
Full year EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, expanding by 234 basis points over FY25 due to better scale and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25. This improvement was driven by better scale, improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Full year PAT margins improved to 5.20%, marking an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR211.8 crores, delivering a robust growth of 88% YoY, with PAT margins improving to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Adoption of Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms helps manage volatility and maintain margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has also strengthened its risk management framework through Proactive adoption of Gold Metal Loans (GML) and hedging mechanisms to manage volatility and maintain margin stability, effectively safeguarding inventory against gold price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 28% to 30% of inventory gains were reflected in the books for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall same-store sales growth stood at 52% during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not planned for any long-term borrowings as capital requirements are largely driven by inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: No, we have not yet planned for any long-term borrowings. If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory. So, our capital requirement is largely driven by inventory, and there is no immediate need for long-term funding.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volume growth remained under pressure during FY26, registering an overall decline of around 20% due to high and volatile gold prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall. This trend was largely in line with the broader industry, where volume growth remained under pressure due to high gold prices.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets increasing the studded ratio to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: As of now our business is doing like between 6% to 7% of the studded mix. And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its footprint in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to target Jaipur for expansion within the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to grow at an annual rate of 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving EBITDA margins between 8% and 8.5% by the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a long-term goal of reaching around 51 stores by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets the online omni-channel segment to contribute around 3% to 5% of revenue over the next five years.
management_commitments.quote: Based on our current plans, we expect this channel to contribute around 3% to 5% of our revenue over the next five years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
